name: What is the difference between mold remediation and mold removal?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between mold remediation and mold removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold remediation is a comprehensive process that goes beyond just removing visible mold. It involves identifying and correcting the moisture problem that caused the mold, containing the affected area to prevent cross-contamination, removing mold-contaminated materials, cleaning and disinfecting salvageable items, drying the area completely, and restoring the affected property. Mold removal, while a key part of remediation, often refers specifically to the physical act of getting rid of mold. Remediation encompasses the entire strategy to return the environment to a healthy, mold-free condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold remediation is a comprehensive process that includes identifying moisture sources, containment, removal, cleaning, drying, and restoration. Mold removal is specifically the physical act of getting rid of mold.
